name: Security Scanner Portal Page
description: Port Yang's Factor_Scanning_Model.xlsm to the portal as a new Security Scanner page. Multi-factor security screening across 6 universes (S&P 500, Russell 1000, Russell 1000 Value, MSCI ACWI ex-US, MSCI EAFE, MSCI EAFE Value) and 284 factors across 11 categories. PMs select factors, assign weights, and see dynamically ranked securities.
